tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Flexi Pack Printed 5 Layered Film for Packing Milk-The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the Goods/Material (s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80% of the quantity or Rs.12.80 Crore turnover in polythene manufacturing products, required in any one of the last 3 years.

the tenderer, as authorized representative, has supplied,the Goods/Material (s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 30% of the quantity Or 4.88 Crore turnover in polythene manufacturing products(at least 20% in milk film business)similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years

Supply of Aluminium Alloy 40 ltrs capacity can with lid -The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the Goods/Material (s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80% of the quantity / Value turnover required in any one of the last 3 years.

Spare Lid -the tenderer, as authorized representative, has supplied, the Goods/Material (s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 30% of the quantity / Value turnover required in any one of the last 3 years.
All Other Terms and conditions as per Tender Document.
